grind.itemGoals.noteLawsOrder: Eighteen Haunting and eighteen Vexatious Memories of the Dying per weapon, from FATEs in the Stormblood zones while The Resistance Remembers is active.
grind.itemGoals.noteDemiatma: Three of each of the six Demiatma per weapon, from FATEs in the Dawntrail zones while Arcane Artistry is active.
grind.itemGoals.notePaste: 1,200 Crystal Paste per weapon, from FATEs anywhere in Dawntrail while In Pursuit of Perfection is active.

changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
changelog.r21800.1: Added the Mount option under Settings > Travel: pick which of your flying mounts AFG rides when it travels or mounts up while waiting, instead of the mount roulette. Requested in issue #83
changelog.r21800.2: Fixed FATEs whose center lies below the ground, like the ones at The Imperious in Kozama'uka: the flight there no longer dives into the floor and stalls on arrival. Reported in issue #82
changelog.r21800.3: Fixed getting stuck behind walls in FATEs: in Collect FATEs the character walks around to an item BossMod keeps running into a wall toward, and ranged jobs that are in range of a mob but cannot hit it now walk closer. Reported in issue #82
changelog.r21800.4: Split Settings > General in two: mount choice, economy mode, zone swaps, Twist of Fate and Collect hand-ins now live in the new Settings > Travel tab, while General keeps language, window and run options
changelog.r21800.5: Added Teleport out when stuck under Settings > General (on by default): when the run makes no progress for 5 minutes (adjustable), AFG teleports to the nearest aetheryte in the zone and carries on, for example after landing on water where the yo-kai minion cannot be summoned. Reported in issue #87
changelog.r21700.1: Added the Mount while waiting for FATEs option under Settings > General: mounts after a short delay while you wait for a FATE to spawn, and stays off on Yo-kai medal runs. Contributed by lizvik
changelog.r21700.2: Fixed trips to a FATE staying on the ground when flying became available only after the route was planned: travel now replans for flight, up to twice. Contributed by lizvik
changelog.r21700.3: Added Economy mode under Settings > General: skips the teleport to the aetheryte nearest the next FATE in the same zone and flies there instead to save gil. Teleports to other zones and stuck recovery still happen
changelog.r21600.1: Added your Bicolor Gemstone count to the title strip and the live tracker, turning amber at your auto-trade threshold and rose at the 1500 cap
changelog.r21600.2: Added the Summon chocobo toggle under Settings > Consumables: turn it off to keep BossMod's FATE helper from using Gysahl Greens during runs, without changing your BossMod preset. Contributed by lizvik
changelog.r21600.3: Added a Buy Me a Coffee button under Patreon on the About page
changelog.r21500.1: Fixed the Relic goals asking for the Yo-kai Watch before they would start
changelog.r21500.2: Fixed a Relic run being able to switch to the yo-kai medal zones partway through on a character that owns a yo-kai minion
changelog.r21400.1: Overhauled the Grind page: a Goal section with Farm, Ranks, Relics and Events tabs, a live status on every goal card, and two plain questions for how long to run and what to do afterwards
changelog.r21400.2: Added the Shared FATE ranks goal: grinds each zone until its rank is maxed, then moves on, with the rank shown on every Shadowbringers and later zone card
changelog.r21400.3: Added six relic and item goals: Atma, Luminous Crystals, Memories of the Dying, Haunting and Vexatious Memories, Demiatma and Crystal Paste
changelog.r21400.4: Added run limits that work with any goal: stop after a number of FATEs or a length of time
changelog.r21400.5: Added /afg start, stop, stop soft and run <count>, and Ctrl+click on Stop to finish the current FATE first
changelog.r21400.6: Added filters for long FATEs and a fixed level window, and a Keep Twist of Fate option that holds zone swaps while the bonus is up
changelog.r21400.7: Added a setting for how long to wait in an empty zone before swapping, which the pacing roll now respects
changelog.r21400.8: Improved the live tracker: passed-over FATEs are listed with the reason, a click walks you to a FATE while idle, and the FATE name format is configurable
changelog.r21400.9: Fixed the level range and skipped FATE types not applying to a FATE you were already standing in or died in
changelog.r21400.10: Fixed FATEs skipped for routing trouble staying skipped for the whole session; they are retried after the next completion
changelog.r21300.1: Added the Console page to view, filter and copy the plugin's logs
changelog.r21300.2: Added this changelog, with a badge whenever an update brings something new
changelog.r21300.3: Overhauled the About page, with the updated Discord link
about.support.title: Made with love and care
about.support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon or buying me a coffee means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.

about.linkHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
about.discordBody: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.
about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. FATE and zone names always follow the game client.
settings.cat.travelSub: Mounts, teleports, zone swaps and how FATEs are played.
settings.cat.filtersSub: Keeps the plugin off dying or late FATEs.
settings.cat.classesSub: Switch gearsets on start, and advance to the next class when one hits its level cap.
settings.cat.gemstonesSub: Auto-spend Bicolor Gemstones once the wallet hits your threshold.
settings.cat.repairSub: Auto-repair gear when equipped item condition drops below the threshold.
settings.cat.consumablesSub: Keep food and medicine buffs up while grinding: Well Fed is a free +3% EXP.
settings.cat.humanizerSub: Act less like a bot: vary your timing between FATEs and take periodic city breaks in a random hub.
settings.cat.partyInvitesSub: Auto-decline incoming party invites during a run, after a human-like delay, with an optional reply.
settings.cat.gmAlertSub: Detects nearby Game Masters and reacts: stop the bot, ping you, or take more drastic action.
settings.general.openOnLoginHelp: Pop the main window automatically the next time you log in.
settings.general.livePopoutHelp: Show the live FATE tracker as a small overlay window so you can keep it visible while the main window is closed.
settings.general.nameFormatHelp: How FATE names read in the running panel and the live tracker. Tokens: {Level}, {Name}, {Id}, {Progress}, {TimeRemaining}, {Distance}, {State}.
settings.general.swapZonesHelp: When the current zone runs out of eligible FATEs, jump to the next zone in your priority order.
settings.general.swapWaitHelp: How long to sit in an empty zone before jumping to the next one. With pacing on, the real wait is rolled around this value so a zone full of AFG users does not all leave at once.
settings.general.keepTwistHelp: While the Twist of Fate bonus is up, stay in the zone: no zone swap, no teleport shortcut, and no rotating past a finished zone until it wears off.
settings.general.mountWhileWaitingHelp: Mount after a short delay while idle and waiting for FATEs. Disabled for Yo-kai medal runs.
settings.general.mountHelp: The mount AFG summons when it travels or mounts up while waiting. Random uses the game's mount roulette. Only flying mounts this character owns are listed.
settings.general.mountNotOwned: This character does not own {0}; AFG uses the mount roulette instead.
settings.general.economyTravelHelp: Save gil by never teleporting to an aetheryte closer to the next FATE in the same zone; AFG mounts up and flies there instead. Teleports to other zones, and the teleport used to recover from being stuck, still happen.
settings.general.autoPauseHelp: Pause the run while you are inside a duty, trial, raid, or any other instanced content, then resume it once you are back outside. Your zones, goal, and session stats are kept, and paused time does not count toward a time-based goal.
settings.general.autoResumeHelp: If the grind hits an unrecoverable error and stops, automatically restart it (up to 3 times in 5 minutes) instead of ending the run. Leave off if you want faults to surface.
settings.general.stuckRescueHelp: If the run makes no progress for this long (no FATE finished, no zone change, no combat, and the character stays within 15 m of one spot), teleport to the nearest aetheryte in the zone and carry on from there. Catches cases like landing on water, where the yo-kai minion cannot be summoned. Stops after 3 teleports with no FATE finished in between.
settings.general.stuckRescueAfterHelp: How long the run must make no progress before AFG teleports out.
settings.general.collectHandInHelp: AFG walks to the hand-in NPC as soon as you hold a batch, and turns in any leftovers once the FATE hits 100%. Off leaves turn-ins to BossMod's FATE helper, which only hands in at 10 items.
settings.general.collectHandInBatchHelp: How many items to collect before each trip to the NPC. Smaller batches waste fewer items when other players finish the FATE first; larger ones mean fewer trips.
settings.filters.minTimeHelp: Skip FATEs that have less than this many seconds left. Keeps you off corpse-FATEs other players are finishing.
settings.filters.maxProgressHelp: Skip FATEs already past this percent. Keeps you off near-finished FATEs others are clearing.
settings.filters.maxDurationHelp: Skip FATEs whose full timer is longer than a limit, such as 30-minute boss FATEs that rarely finish.
settings.filters.maxDurationLimitHelp: FATEs with a longer full duration than this are skipped, whatever time is left on them.
settings.filters.maxDurationOff: FATEs of any length are eligible.
settings.filters.levelWindowHelp: Only target FATEs between two fixed levels, whatever your own level is. Handy for leveling a specific bracket or staying out of a zone's high-level corner.
settings.filters.levelWindowOff: No fixed level window; only the band around your level applies, if it is on.
settings.filters.levelRangeHelp: Only target FATEs within a level range of your current level. Useful in zones that mix low- and high-level FATEs (e.g. Lv 10-15 and Lv 40-45 in the same area) so the grinder doesn't drag you into one that can kill you.
settings.filters.levelRangeOff: All FATE levels in your selected zones are eligible.
settings.filters.levelBelowHelp: Skip FATEs more than this many levels below your current level.
settings.filters.levelAboveHelp: Skip FATEs more than this many levels above your current level. Set to 0 to never fight FATEs above your own level.
settings.filters.skipTypesHelp: Toggle on a type to skip every FATE of that kind. Useful if you don't enjoy escorts or collect hand-ins.
settings.filters.rule.normalHelp: Kill the target mobs in the FATE ring.
settings.filters.rule.collectHelp: Gather items off mobs or nodes and turn them in.
settings.filters.rule.escortHelp: Protect an NPC that walks a fixed path.
settings.filters.rule.defendHelp: Hold a point or NPC against waves.
settings.filters.rule.eventHelp: Dialogue-style FATE that starts by interacting with an NPC.
settings.filters.rule.chaseHelp: Pursue a moving enemy across the zone.
settings.filters.collectTextAdvanceNote: TextAdvance is installed but disabled. Collect hand-ins usually work anyway (AFG drives the turn-in directly), but enabling TextAdvance's "Enable plugin" toggle is the safe fallback if a hand-in stalls.
settings.filters.fatePriorityHelp: Order the rules used to pick the next FATE. Top rule wins; ties fall through to the next. Reset restores the recommended order.
settings.filters.sort.name: Name
settings.filters.autoBlacklistDeathsHelp: Once you die in the same FATE this many times in one run, it is added to the list below and the grind moves on. Remove it there to try it again.
settings.filters.autoBlacklistDeathsOff: A FATE you keep dying in is retried after every revive.
settings.filters.deathsBeforeBlacklistHe: Deaths inside the same FATE during one run. A death anywhere else does not count.
settings.filters.addByNameHelp: Pulled live from game data, sorted A-Z. Type to search. Use this for FATEs you never want to trigger, like a world boss everyone is waiting on, without needing it to be up.
settings.filters.blacklistedHelp: Blacklisted FATEs are skipped while grinding. The ban button in the Live FATEs window adds to this list too. Remove one here to grind it again.
settings.filters.noFatesInData: No FATEs found in game data.
settings.classes.switchOnStartHelp: Equip the first eligible gearset below when you press Start. Disable to leave the run on whatever class you're currently on.
settings.classes.switchingOff: Class switching is off. Enable it to configure the queue.
settings.classes.allCappedHelp: What to do after every queued class has hit its level cap.
settings.classes.doneKeep.name: Keep grinding on the last class
settings.classes.doneKeep.detail: When every queued class is capped, keep going on the last one.
settings.classes.doneStop.name: Stop the run
settings.classes.doneStop.detail: When every queued class is capped, end the run.
settings.classes.addGearsetHelp: Use the gear-set number shown in your in-game Gear Set list (1-100). Class is resolved automatically.
settings.classes.queueOrderHelp: Order matters: top entry runs first, then advances when its level cap is hit.
settings.classes.noGearsets: No gearsets found. Save one in-game (Character -> Gear Set List) first.
settings.classes.noClassesQueued: No classes queued. Automation will use whatever class you're on.
settings.gems.autoTradeHelp: When your Bicolor Gemstone inventory reaches the threshold below, the plugin teleports to a trader and buys the item.
settings.gems.autoTradeOff: Auto-trade is off. Enable it to configure the trade.
settings.gems.textAdvanceNote: TextAdvance is installed but disabled. Auto-trade may stall at the trader's dialogue; turn on TextAdvance's "Enable plugin" toggle for reliable trading.
settings.gems.thresholdHelp: Gem count that triggers the trade. Game cap is 1500. Lower values trade more often so fewer FATEs are wasted near cap.
settings.gems.itemToBuyHelp: Pulled live from game data, sorted A-Z. Type to search. Cost shown in gems per one.
settings.gems.traderLocked: No trader you can reach sells {0}. It is only sold in {1}. Attune an aetheryte there, or pick another item.
settings.gems.traderMissing: No known Bicolor trader sells {0}. Pick another item.
settings.gems.spendStrategyHelp: How much each trade spends when it fires.
settings.gems.spendAll.name: Spend all gemstones
settings.gems.spendAll.detail: Spend everything above the reserve on each trade.
settings.gems.spendUpTo.name: Spend up to a set amount
settings.gems.spendUpTo.detail: Cap how many gems each trade is allowed to spend.
settings.gems.buyFixed.name: Buy a fixed number
settings.gems.buyFixed.detail: Buy a set quantity of the item on each trade.
settings.gems.buyQuantityHelp: How many of the item to buy per trade.
settings.gems.reserveHelp: Gems left untouched on every trade. Use this when you want to save toward a pricier item without turning auto-trade off.
settings.gems.whenDoneHelp: What to do once the buy succeeds.
settings.gems.afterResume.name: Resume the grind
settings.gems.afterResume.detail: Keep grinding FATEs in the same zone after the buy.
settings.gems.afterStop.name: Stop the run
settings.gems.afterStop.detail: End the run once the buy succeeds.
settings.gems.previewCannotAfford: Threshold/reserve won't afford any {0} at {1}g each.
settings.gems.previewBuy: At threshold {0}g (keeping {1}g), next trade buys ~{2} x {3} for {4}g.
settings.repair.autoRepairHelp: Between FATEs, when the lowest equipped item drops to or below the threshold, the plugin runs a repair. At 0% the gear stops working, so keep some margin.
settings.repair.autoRepairOff: Auto-repair is off. Enable it to configure repair.
settings.repair.thresholdHelp: Trips when the worst equipped slot reaches this condition percentage. 20% leaves comfortable margin before the 0% breakdown.
settings.repair.sourceHelp: How the repair is performed. Self-repair uses Dark Matter from your bag (no travel). NPC repair travels to your Grand Company mender.
settings.repair.selfThenNpc.name: Self, then NPC
settings.repair.selfThenNpc.detail: Use Dark Matter from your bag first; fall back to the Grand Company mender when you run out.
settings.repair.selfOnly.name: Self only
settings.repair.selfOnly.detail: Repair with Dark Matter from your bag. No travel.
settings.repair.npcOnly.name: NPC only
settings.repair.npcOnly.detail: Travel to your Grand Company mender (or a custom NPC) and pay in seals.
settings.repair.customNpcHelp: Optional. Travel to any repair NPC instead of the Grand Company mender. Target the NPC in-game, then click "Set from target". Clear to fall back to the GC mender.
settings.repair.npcNote: NPC repair uses your custom repair NPC if set, otherwise your Grand Company mender (teleports there and pays in company seals). A custom NPC removes the Grand Company requirement.
settings.repair.noTargetChat: [AFG] No target - target a repair NPC first, then click again.
settings.consumables.autoSummonChocoboHe: Let BossMod's FATE helper resummon your chocobo with Gysahl Greens when its timer drops below 60 seconds while synced to a FATE. Turn off to stop that during runs; your BossMod preset itself is never changed.
settings.consumables.autoConsumeHelp: Use food and medicine between FATEs to keep their buffs up; Well Fed alone is a free +3% EXP. Items are consumed only when out of combat, and refreshed before the buff runs out.
settings.consumables.autoConsumeOff: Auto-consume is off. Enable it to pick items.
settings.consumables.refreshUnderHelp: Re-consume once the buff has fewer than this many minutes left. 0 only re-applies after it fully wears off. Food and medicine last 30 minutes.
settings.consumables.addItemHelp: Pick from the food and medicine in your bag. HQ is used automatically when you have it.
settings.consumables.activeItemsHelp: Each is kept active in order; the next available one is consumed if the first runs out.
settings.consumables.noneInBag: No food or medicine in your bag. Stock some, then add it here.
settings.consumables.noItemsAdded: No items added - nothing will be consumed.
settings.humanizer.enableHelp: Every N FATEs, teleport to a random selected city and wander around for a few minutes before resuming. Helps you avoid player reports by acting a little more human, useful when you leave the PC running for long sessions and don't want others noticing you grinding FATEs non-stop.
settings.humanizer.off: Humanizer is off. Enable it to configure breaks.
settings.humanizer.fatesBetweenHelp: Take a break after this many completed FATEs. The counter resets after each break.
settings.humanizer.breakLengthHelp: A random duration between these two values is rolled for each break.
settings.humanizer.pauseBetweenHelp: After arriving at each random point, stand still for a random duration in this range before walking somewhere else.
settings.humanizer.walkDistanceHelp: Each random destination is rolled this many meters away from your current position. Larger ranges cover more of the city; smaller ranges keep you near the aetheryte.
settings.humanizer.allowedCitiesHelp: Tick the cities the plugin is allowed to teleport to. One is picked at random each break. Untick cities you haven't unlocked or don't want visited.
settings.humanizer.noCities: No cities selected - Humanizer will skip the break and keep grinding.
settings.humanizer.pacingEnableHelp: Every player running AFG sees a FATE end at the same moment, so without this they all move on, teleport and swap zones in perfect sync. When on, each step waits a short random delay, and the teleport shortcut distance, zone swap wait, follow-up watch, release after a KO and FATEs between breaks are rolled fresh every time.
settings.humanizer.pacingOff: Pacing is off. Every step starts the moment it can, in sync with other AFG users.
settings.humanizer.reactionDelayHelp: How long to wait after a FATE ends or a new one appears before moving on. Rolls lean toward the short end, and now and then a longer pause is added.
settings.humanizer.pickVarietyHelp: When a few FATEs rank about the same, head to a random one of them instead of always the top pick. AFG users nearby then spread out, at the cost of slightly longer trips.
settings.invites.autoDeclineHelp: While a grind run is active, automatically decline incoming party invites after a short random delay. Invites that arrive while idle or playing manually are left alone for you to handle.
settings.invites.autoDeclineOff: Auto-decline is off. Enable it to configure it.
settings.invites.delayHelp: Wait a random time in this range before declining, so it looks like you noticed the popup and dismissed it yourself.
settings.invites.sendReplyHelp: After declining, send a chat message so it reads like a polite human brush-off rather than an instant silent decline.
settings.invites.channelHelp: Where the message goes. "Tell inviter" whispers the person who invited you. Ignored when your message starts with a slash command.
settings.invites.channelTell.name: Tell inviter
settings.invites.channelTell.detail: Whisper the person who invited you.
settings.invites.channelSay.name: Say
settings.invites.channelSay.detail: Local /say, heard by players near you.
settings.invites.channelYell.name: Yell
settings.invites.messageHelp: Use {name} for the inviter's character name and {world} for their home world. If the message begins with "/", it's sent verbatim as a command (e.g. /tell {name}@{world} busy right now!).
settings.gm.stopRunHelp: Halt automation immediately when a GM appears in your zone. Strongly recommended; the rest of the alerts are useless if the bot keeps grinding.
settings.gm.toastHelp: Pop a Dalamud toast: "GM <name> is nearby!"
settings.gm.chatHelp: Print a red chat warning into your local log.
settings.gm.soundHelp: Plays a series of system beeps through your speakers. Loud enough to grab your attention if you're tabbed away.
settings.gm.beepCountHelp: How many beeps to play in the burst.
settings.gm.commandsHelp: Chat commands to run when a GM is spotted. Useful for things like /logout, /sh stay calm, or a macro.
settings.gm.killHelp: Hard-terminate the game process via /xlkill. The last-resort option; no goodbyes, no cutscene, no logout. You'll get a disconnect.
plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto FATE Grind window. /afg start | stop | stop soft (finish the current FATE first) | run <count> (stop after that many FATEs) | pause | config | stats | deps | log | changelog | about | target.
